gen-gf-bellota-gf-actor: Actor reads modern and tidy, with wide s curves barely curling in. Bellota's strokes all share one stylus width and its s ends hang far from the spine, which is where the pull comes from.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-graduate: Hanging s ends and stylus-width strokes mark Bellota out right away. Graduate, a serif with generous spacing and no contrast between stems and joins, brings a bookish, dignified steadiness underneath.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-znamenny-musical-: Distinctive at first glance, Bellota traces every stroke at stylus width, no brush swell. Noto Znamenny Musical Notation, a sans-serif, does the clean, modern part, its terminals stopping far from the stem.
gen-gf-bellota-plus-jakarta-sans: Distinctive up top, Bellota hangs its s ends far from the spine and traces every stroke at stylus width. Plus Jakarta Sans runs on precisely, monoline with curve endings held well apart.
gen-gf-bellota-sora: Sora reads precise and geometric, its curves turning corners with no pressure swell and its c and s held widely apart. Paragraphs move along crisply, with Bellota's hanging s ends flavoring the top.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-familjen-grotesk: Open shapes, no shading: Bellota Text stays smooth and plain while Familjen Grotesk leaves its bowls unfinished on one side. Familjen's taller lowercase moves with a livelier stride than the heading's moderate one.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-ranade: Ranade reads organic and composed, its weight shifting only slightly like stretched rubber cord, stroke ends set far apart. Bellota Text, by contrast, keeps horizontals matching verticals in thickness.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-roundo: Bellota Text opens its curves wide and skips calligraphic shading entirely. Roundo, a sans whose n has arch and stem matching, keeps small counters unclogged under that shading-free heading.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-actor: Wire-cut strokes and open curves give Bellota Text a sharp look. Bellota Text does the attention-grabbing; Actor, a sans with wide s curves barely curled in, does the modern, clean reading.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-brawler: Bellota Text matches its diagonals to its stems and leaves its curves open, free of any calligraphic shading. Brawler's softly varied strokes add a literary, refined warmth to the text.
